Compute the average fee rate (`feerate`, ignoring missing values) for each pair of orderslink and account scope (`users.acctscope`). queries:
WITH pair_avg AS (
  SELECT f.orderslink AS orderslink,
         u.acctscope AS acctscope,
         AVG(f.feerate) AS avg_feerate
  FROM fees f
  JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
  GROUP BY f.orderslink, u.acctscope
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_feerate) AS mean_avg FROM pair_avg
),
excess AS (
  SELECT p.orderslink, p.acctscope, p.avg_feerate,
         p.avg_feerate - o.mean_avg AS excess
  FROM pair_avg p
  CROSS JOIN overall o
  WHERE p.avg_feerate > o.mean_avg
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_feerate, excess,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY acctscope ORDER BY excess DESC) AS rank_in_scope
  FROM excess
)
SELECT orderslink, acctscope, avg_feerate, excess, rank_in_scope
FROM ranked
WHERE rank_in_scope <= 3
ORDER BY acctscope, rank_in_scope;
